title: Candlestick Chart
description: Open, high, low, close as cast candles — price action for a session at a glance.
usage: For price series where the range matters as much as the close: markets, exchange rates, any OHLC data. Up sessions take the accent, down sessions the danger color; the wick is the full range, the body is open to close.
a11y: Nobody can read fourteen candles aloud, so the figure label states the verdict — direction, period and range — and the underlying OHLC table belongs next to the chart for anyone who needs exact values.
